data.explanation: This is a service invoice for garden clean-up and gutter cleaning work done at your home. You should pay the total of €321.30 to the IBAN shown, referencing the invoice number, by the deadline shown (the app calculates it from when you received this invoice). If you don't pay in time, the service provider could send a reminder or charge late fees, though none are mentioned here. Keep this invoice, as craftsman/household services like this can often be partly deducted on your German tax return.
